flaws.F: Strongest, most readable posing of the set, but the new frames drift a little in scale and outline colour and frame 1 crops the blade tip.
flaws.M: Clean and on-model, but timid legs in the anticipation and wind-up make the strike read as competent rather than punchy.
flaws.H: Clean and consistent, but stiff legs and an upright contact with the shield left in front make the blow less forceful.
flaws.S: A tan smudge on the shorts in frames 3-6 and a slightly larger body in frame 1 break consistency in an otherwise strong strike.
flaws.K: Very dynamic, but a heavy magenta halo and the shield flipping to its back side make several frames look like a different render.
flaws.P: Good lunge, but saturated purple outlines and spiky hair in frames 3-7 drift off the reference, with a visible pop from frame 7 back to frame 0.
flaws.B: Frames 1-6 are blurry, smeared resamples with mushy arms that pop hard against the crisp frames 0 and 7.
flaws.D: The sword never swings: the whole sprite just slides left and right as a cut-out, so there is no strike at all.

strike.notes: Ordering done blind before opening ordered strips; D was hardest (frames 4/5 indistinguishable). Outline fringe counts: K and P heaviest, F/H/M/S moderate, B and D none. At 1x all but D read as a strike.
